args: const user = { name: "Ada", greet(word) { return word + ", " + this.name; } }; return handle(user, "greet")("Hi");
const c = { n: 0, add(a, b) { this.n += a + b; return this.n; } }; const add = handle(c, "add"); add(1, 2); return add(3, 4);
const c = { n: 5, get() { return this.n; } }; const get = handle(c, "get"); c.n = 6; return get();
const c = { n: 1, get() { return this.n; } }; const get = handle(c, "get"); c.get = () => "new"; return get();
const a = { n: 1, get() { return this.n; } }; const b = { n: 2, get: a.get }; return [handle(a, "get")(), handle(b, "get")()];
const c = { n: 3, get() { return this.n; } }; return [1, 2].map(handle(c, "get"));
